_comment: HTTP (streamable) transport. Start the server first with 'python -m netops_mcp.server_http' (or 'docker compose up'), then point your MCP client at its URL. Use this url form instead of command/args: 'python -m netops_mcp.server_http' speaks HTTP on a port, not stdio. For stdio, see cursor_mcp_config.json.
_auth: security.require_auth defaults to true, so the server answers 401 without a key. Generate one and register its hash with 'python scripts/generate_api_key.py --hash --config config/config.json', then put the PLAIN key below (the config file stores only the sha256 digest). X-API-Key works too. Only drop this header if you have deliberately set security.require_auth to false.
